description: The loop contract of llm.chat (RFC-0011): one model turn of an agent loop per call, the transcript in the helper's own store. mercury-python and mercury-nodejs ship this file byte-identical and run every case against their own fake of the Anthropic SDK and their memory transcript store. A case names the route, the config keys in force (the harness installs the fake backend under llm.backend, as for llm-helper-vectors.json, and a memory store when llm.transcript.store is memory), the ids the helper draws for new conversations, in order, and its steps. A step may first advance the store's clock by advance_s seconds; it names the request body and what the fake provider does (the provider kinds of llm-helper-vectors.json, a message carrying content blocks that the fake returns as the SDK does); the expectation is the exact SDK call when one is made (namespace, parameters, options), then either the reply map or the error (status and message fragments), and the stored record of the step's conversation afterwards (the step's conversation field, else its body's, else the case's first id): null when none is held, else its turn count, whether it is closed, the pending call ids, the seconds it has left to live and its number of messages.
